summary: Defined provider-neutral NodeExecutor contracts, immutable release registry resolution, a NodeRun record schema/example, and port exports for runtime-gated node execution.

contract_properties.details: The request contains a PlanIR, one PlanNodeIR from that plan, runtime CapabilityGrant records, workspace_ref, branch, run_id, and payload. __post_init__ rejects nodes that are not part of the supplied plan and rejects requests without grants.

contract_properties.property: NodeExecutionResult is status-only for task completion
contract_properties.details: The result can report accepted, needs_human, rejected, error, or blocked and includes taskCompletedStateUpdateAttempted. It does not expose a Goal or Task completed-state mutation API.

contract_properties.property: Registry resolves by immutable node type and release
contract_properties.details: NodeExecutorRegistry keys by (node_type, release_ref), rejects duplicate registrations, and rejects latest or digest-less release refs.

contract_properties.property: Provider-specific AgentDriver remains outside the contract
contract_properties.details: Node executor contracts import PlanIR and CapabilityGrant records only. Provider drivers remain behind the existing AgentDriver adapter port.

acceptance_coverage.coverage: Request contract requires PlanIR, PlanNodeIR, and CapabilityGrant inputs.
Result contract records taskCompletedStateUpdateAttempted=false by default and exposes no completion writer.
Contract and lint paths contain no provider SDK imports.

verification.summary: AHRA lint: 0 failures; node-run example validates

known_limitations: This task defines the executor primitive and compatibility adapter only; DAG scheduling remains out of scope.
NodeRun artifact records do not self-reference their own artifact id; the returned NodeExecutionResult carries the node-run artifact id after the artifact is written.
